24.verdict: ahead of the channel's earlier Shorts at this age: 1495 views against a median of 826 (1.8x)

worked: The counterintuitive opening premise ('Pluto has not finished a single orbit since its discovery') drove strong top-of-funnel reach, achieving 1,495 views and 53.2 views per hour—the highest total views in the cohort.
hurt: Meandering into generic Pluto trivia in beats 2 through 5 (Clyde Tombaugh, moon size comparisons, and IAU demotion reasons) diluted the central premise, pulling engagement down to a cohort-low 2.1 likes per 100 views and 0 comments.
diagnosis.change_next: Keep the middle beats strictly focused on escalating the hook's core mystery: cut generic demotion and discovery trivia (beats 2–5), and instead contrast human historical milestones since 1930 against how little Pluto has moved along its 248-year path before landing on the 2178 finish line.

72.verdict: ahead of the channel's earlier Shorts at this age: 1517 views against a median of 1014 (1.5x)

worked: Total view velocity held strong at 1,517 views and 19.9 views per hour (well above the peer group average of ~11.9), supported by strong YouTube Search traffic (138 views).
Engaged share reached 0.566, outperforming multiple peers at this age (which ranged from 0.457 to 0.541) and showing that viewers who stayed found the core subject engaging.
hurt: Initial retention was the weakest in the set, with watching_at_5 dropping to 1.139 (all peers were 1.233–1.477), indicating an immediate swipe drop in the first two seconds.

Mid-video retention collapsed, with watching_at_50 plunging to 0.401 and avg_viewed falling to 48.02% (peers averaged ~70%), as beats 2 through 5 diverted into Clyde Tombaugh and demotion facts rather than explaining the unfinished orbit promised by the hook.
Poor completion rate (watching_at_end hit just 0.257 vs. peer average >0.42) restricted feed distribution, sinking feed_share to 0.577 compared to the typical 0.90+.
diagnosis.change_next: Eliminate tangential backstory after the hook; replace the Beat 2 history detour (Clyde Tombaugh and the blink comparator) with the immediate mechanics of the 248-year orbit so the script delivers directly on the hook's premise before the 50% mark.
